topic: DWG TOLERANCE DIMSTYLE hard-pointer to DXF group-3 name binding

failing_witness.source: Current code path: DRW_Tolerance::parseDwg retains dimStyleH; dwgReader::readDwgEntity dispatches the TOLERANCE callback without resolving that handle, leaving the constructor's STANDARD dimStyleName in place.
affected_fields: DWG TOLERANCE DIMSTYLE hard pointer (ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.49)
DXF TOLERANCE group 3 dimension-style name (Autodesk DXF TOLERANCE reference)
failing_witness.current_effect: A DWG tolerance using a non-STANDARD DIMSTYLE can be exported with group 3 STANDARD, silently changing its style association.

existing_providers.evidence: findTableName(DRW::DIMSTYLE, handle) and DIMSTYLE handle map already resolve DIMENSION and LEADER references before callback delivery.
DRW_Tolerance::parseDwg reads the final hard pointer into dimStyleH; its DXF parser/writer use dimStyleName.
writeTolerance emits group 3 from dimStyleName and currently has no guard against an unresolved DWG style pointer.
Existing source/graph policy requires exact target role and fail-closed output when a required target cannot be resolved.

bounded_scope.admit: A parsed DWG TOLERANCE whose nonzero DIMSTYLE hard pointer resolves to exactly one loaded DIMSTYLE record; carry that record's name to the DXF group-3 writer field.
bounded_scope.refuse: A parsed DWG TOLERANCE whose required DIMSTYLE pointer does not resolve; do not silently substitute STANDARD.
exclude: Tolerance rendering or GD&T semantic qualification

implementation_steps: Resolve the TOLERANCE DIMSTYLE handle in the existing DWG entity dispatch, preserving the current STANDARD default only for non-DWG/authored carriers that have no unresolved source pointer.
Represent an unresolved parsed DWG style without a misleading fallback and make writeTolerance reject that unqualified carrier before opening its record scope.

Add a runtime-generated AC1024 DWG with one custom DIMSTYLE and TOLERANCE; read it through dwgR/dx_iface, verify the exact handle-to-name mapping, write ASCII and Binary DXF, and verify group-3 typed readback.
Add a missing-target DWG control proving atomic refusal and destination preservation, then correct the source handle/name and retry through the same adapter.

validation.normal: PASS: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg2dxf_adapter_tests -j4; ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R '^libdxfrw_tolerance_dimstyle_reference_binding$' --output-on-failure (0.60 s).
validation.asan: PASS: cmake --build build-asan-custom --target libdxfrw_dwg2dxf_adapter_tests -j4; ctest --test-dir build-asan-custom -R '^libdxfrw_tolerance_dimstyle_reference_binding$' --output-on-failure (1.18 s).
validation.fixture_policy: Author the DWG and DXF files from scratch at test runtime under a temporary directory; commit no drawing fixture.

claim_boundary: Exact source handle-to-DXF style-name transport and unresolved-target refusal only. It does not qualify tolerance rendering, override semantics, native behavior, or broad producer support.

sources.title: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §20.4.49 TOLERANCE (46)
